text:
m1 - IMPLEMENTED THE RULING AND IT PRODUCES THE OPPOSITE DEFECT. Reverted, not committed. The ruling's first law is TRUE BUT VACUOUS ON OUR FIXTURE, and that is the whole problem.

WHAT I BUILT, exactly as ruled: cost = (sum over present of w_t * x_t) * (W_all / W_present) + prior, plus CostBreakdown.supportWeight naming the imputation.

WHAT HAPPENED: align breaks badly. Intrusion takes 0.597 of unit 1's row; the Viterbi path collapses to External; six assertions fail including "unit 1 anchors to event 1 or its scene".

WHY - AND IT IS THE PREMISE, NOT THE ARITHMETIC. "At full support the factor is exactly 1, so every currently-complete cell is bit-identical." True. But NO CELL ON WOG IS EVER COMPLETE:

  W_all              = 4.350   (all eight terms)
  W_present 5 terms  = 3.200   scale 1.3594
  W_present 6 terms  = 3.350   scale 1.2985

CHART AND STRUCTURAL ARE ABSENT FOR THE WHOLE CORPUS - WarOfTheGhostsModel.scala:19 says the fixture "contains no charts". So the bit-identical law has NOTHING TO PROTECT here: every source cost inflates by 30 to 36 percent while externalFloor, a flat constant, does not move. Everything flips to External. Same defect as d_ent, sign reversed.

THE REAL DISTINCTION WE ARE MISSING: A TERM CAN BE ABSENT FOR TWO DIFFERENT REASONS.
  INELIGIBLE  - no chart exists anywhere in this corpus, so d_chart could never have been measured.
                Scaling as though it should have been is inventing a dimension the data cannot have.
  MISSING     - this unit named no sensory terms, though another unit did. That IS what scaling is
                for: the term was measurable in principle and absent in this instance.

Today the blend cannot tell them apart, and W_all treats both as "should have been measured".

AND THIS IS ALREADY FILED. bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV: "features: Estimate cannot express Ineligible - the eligible/missing distinction is portable and currently exists only in embed-bench". The chief deferred it in the morning as too wide, measured at 31 match sites. IT IS THE SAME PROBLEM. The blend needs to scale over ELIGIBLE weight, not total weight, and nothing in the type system currently says which terms were eligible.

SO I DO NOT THINK THE BLEND CAN BE FIXED CORRECTLY BEFORE THE ELIGIBLE/MISSING DISTINCTION EXISTS. It could be fixed EXPEDIENTLY - hardcode "Chart and Structural are eligible only when the view has charts" inside the cost model - but that is a convention a consumer must know, which is the class of thing ADR 0003 exists to eliminate, and I would be building the thing I have spent the day arguing against.

Reverted. Reservations held pending your view; say the word and I release them.
